honors.title: Technology Entrepreneurship Part I & II - Online Course Statement of Accomplishment
honors.description: This course introduces the fundamentals of technology entrepreneurship, pioneered in Silicon Valley and now spreading across the world. You will learn the process technology entrepreneurs use to start companies. It involves taking a technology idea and finding a high-potential commercial opportunity, gathering resources such as talent and capital, figuring out how to sell and market the idea, and managing rapid growth.
honors.issuer: Issued by Stanford University through Venture Lab · Jun 2013

projects.title: Sogos
projects.description:
SPA that allows all users across the internet to finally add sounds to their static
images and logos by using file I/O functions from JavaScript to take photos and record their voice via their microphone.
	Uses raw Sql in repository classes to reduce dependence on unnatural LINQ2SQL syntax
	Uses parameritzed Sql queries to prevent Sql Injection attacks
	Requests direct use of users microphone and camera
	Passes 64-bit encoded images/sounds to backend to then store on server
	Front-end built using AngularJS for real SPA experience

projects.title: Wish Heroes
projects.description:
A non-profit crowd-funding platform designed to flatten the playing field by guaranteeing all users who request crowd funding a fair audience. A fair audience is guaranteed by only allowing visitors to view randomly selected crowd funding request one at a time.  It removes the “popularity contest” that drives existing crowd-funding platforms today.
	Developed a pseudo-randomizing Sql server query using LINQ2SQL;
	Passed tokenized JSON objects via AJAX calls from AngularJS to OWIN2 Web API
	Implemented Repository pattern leveraging C#’s class inheritance to create a business layer which abstracted away implementation details from Controller
